Debug a LOGOS program over the Debug Adapter Protocol (stdio).

Speaks DAP with `Content-Length` framing: `launch`, breakpoints, `stackTrace`/`scopes`/`variables`, the stepping verbs, `evaluate`, and — the headline — real reverse execution (`stepBack`/`reverseContinue`, `supportsStepBack: true`). A thin serializer over the same `DebugSession` facade the Studio drawer renders, so an editor and the browser drawer see the same session. Made for editor integrations; humans want `largo repl`.

Usage: largo dap [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo dap
